text.en:
This Order shall take effect on January 6, 1950.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of January, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QURINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
